interface.name: zwp_virtual_keyboard_manager_v1
interface.description: A virtual keyboard manager allows an application to create virtual keyboard objects.

request.name: create_virtual_keyboard
request.description: Creates a new virtual keyboard associated with a seat.

interface.name: zwp_virtual_keyboard_v1
interface.description: The virtual keyboard interface allows a client to inject key events and keymaps. It does not receive events; it is a one-way injection interface.

request.name: keymap
request.description: Provide a file descriptor to the compositor that maps keycodes to keysyms. The file must be in the format specified by the format argument. Must be set before any key events.

entry.name: xkb_v1
entry.summary: libxkbcommon compatible; to determine the xkb keycode, add 8 to the key event keycode

request.name: key
request.description: A key was pressed or released. The time argument is a timestamp in milliseconds with an undefined base. The key is a Linux evdev keycode (the xkb keycode minus 8).

request.name: modifiers
request.description: Notifies the compositor that the modifier and group state has changed. Masks are xkb mod masks: bit N corresponds to mod index N.
